The '''Nuclear Fallen King''' will point its arms upwards, spawning 2-4 [[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]]s at spawn. It is briefly immune to all forms of damage. Attack frequency and walkspeed is increased. |music-1 = [[File:(Official) Tower Defense Simulator OST - Nuclear Fallen King|center|250px|thumb]] }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|oiHSADAsdoisada;lad'111111111111|Beginning of Wave 40 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Nuclear Fallen King''' was the final boss of [[Polluted Wasteland]] [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. It replaced the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] in [[Polluted Wasteland]]. It moved somewhat slowly (during ''Rage Mode'', it moved quite fast for a major boss), but had an outstanding amount of health, had lots of abilities that could stun lots of towers and could destroy units, proving to be one of the hardest challenges of the game. However, it only spawned in [[Polluted Wasteland]], which was a long map with multiple loops, making the enemy far more balanced. It stopped moving when performing its ''Stomp'' and ''Block'' move. It had many immunities, namely burn, freeze, energy and [[Splash Damage]]. ==Appearance== The '''Nuclear Fallen King''' was a radiant green version of the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]. It carried a jade sword and shield. The '''Nuclear Fallen King''' had a granite dark green dominus with glowing green horns. Its armor was granite dark green and appears to be glowing neon green on some parts. It had a dark green belt, gloves and boots. It also had a granite dark green cape. Green smoke and green particles were emitted from its torso. It was normally faceless but upon ''Rage Mode'' being activated, it would gain green glowing eyes. ==Strategy== *Be aware of the [[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]]s that the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' may spawn as it can speed it up massively. **They must be killed quickly otherwise the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' will easily walk past all of your defenses. *The '''Nuclear Fallen King''' has lots of immunities that limits the amount of towers that can be effective against it. **It has [[Freeze Immunity]], so it cannot be frozen by the [[Freezer]] or [[Frost Blaster]]. ***However, these towers can be useful against the [[enemies]] it spawns, especially the [[Circuit (Hardcore)|Circuit]] and [[Rusher (Polluted Wasteland)|Rusher]]. **Due to its large size and [[Energy Immunity]], the [[Electroshocker]] can slow the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' down for a very short period of time instead of stunning it. **It has [[Burn Immunity]], so the [[Pyromancer]] cannot burn the '''Nuclear Fallen King'''. However, it can still deal non-burn damage to it. **The '''Nuclear Fallen King''' also has [[Splash Damage]] immunity. ***While this makes the [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] useless against the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' itself, they may be useful in clearing out the enemies that the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' can spawn. ****[[Military Base]] [[units]] can still damage the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' with collision and gun damage, but not cannon damage. *When the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' performs its ''Block'' ability, it cannot be damaged from any source. It is immobile while this move is performed, as this is mainly to waste time/ability duration. **This can be used as breathing room to manage your towers, but do not use abilities, such as the [[Commander]]'s ''Call to Arms'', during this move. **The '''Nuclear Fallen King's''' ''Block'' prevents all forms of damage. [[Units]], like the [[Military Base]] [[Tank (Unit)|Tank]], will pass through the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' without dealing collision damage. *The '''Nuclear Fallen King''' is accompanied by four [[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]]s. They are always in front of the '''Nuclear Fallen King'''. They should be fought first since they are faster than the '''Nuclear Fallen King'''. **You do not need to kill the [[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]]s spawned by the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' when it performs its ''Rage Mode'' ability as they will not give money when damaged. ***You can still earn money from damaging them with the [[Cowboy]] and {{Color|Golden}} [[Cowboy]]. **However, if they get past by the '''Nuclear Fallen King''', they should be dealt immediately as they can easily walk past your defense due to their high health and defense. *Beware of the '''Nuclear Fallen King's''' ''Stomp'' attack. Its shockwave covers an enormous radius around the boss, stunning any ground troops caught in the radius. **The [[Medic]]'s ability can cleanse towers, as long as the [[Medic]] itself is not stunned. **This ability also deals 750 damage to all [[units]]. This destroys all [[units]] instantly, except for the [[Railgun Tank]]. *Cliff towers, such as the [[Ranger]], are not immune to any attack as the ''Acid Rain'' attack occurs for every ability used. **However, the [[Pursuit]] and [[Ace Pilot]] are immune to all attacks as they are air-based towers. **While the '''Gladiator''' can block one stun every 5-10 seconds, due to the ''Acid Rain'' attack, it will likely always be stunned after an attack. *Try to place towers away from the path as the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' will perform its ''Acid Rain'' attack for every ability it uses. *Multiple high DPS towers, such as [[Minigunner]]s, {{Color|Golden}} [[Minigunner]]s, [[Turret]]s, [[Ranger]]s and [[Accelerator]]s are recommended against the '''Nuclear Fallen King'''. **Make sure to sell any [[Farm]]s to maximize the amount of towers attacking the '''Nuclear Fallen King'''. They do not produce any income anymore, count towards your tower limit, and can be replaced by more useful towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Icons}} 498770eed7c195caf7068a224434bc43.png|'''Nuclear Fallen King''' on the game icon. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} NuclearFallenKingPromotionalImage.png|'''Nuclear Fallen King''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} NuclearFallenKingDI.png|'''Nuclear Fallen King''' on a development image. {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} NuclearKingRender.png|'''Nuclear Fallen King''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Badges}} NFKBadge.png|'''Nuclear Fallen King''' on the “[https://www.roblox.com/badges/2124572797 Defeat Nuclear Fallen King]” [[Badges/Achievement|badge]]. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Nuclear Fallen King's''' theme is a remix of the old [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hvcihildZqs You Lost!] theme. *After the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], when the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' died, its death animation did not play. **Additionally, after ''Rage Mode'' was activated, its sword had purple sparks, which is only meant to occur for the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]]. **The animation for the ''Stomp'' attack also did not play. *Unlike the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]], the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' did not gain shield health when ''Rage Mode'' is activated. *Prior to the [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul Update]], the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' was one of the few enemies to gain a shield. This shield reduced the damage dealt by most towers to 3. *The sword wielded by the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' is a modified version of the {{RLinkC|638089422|Immortal Sword: Venom's Bite}}. ==Update History== *'''29 April 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0]] **'''Nuclear Fallen King''' added. *'''1 May 2020''' - [[Release v1.10|Release v1.10.0b]] **Health increased from 450,000 to 500,000. **''Rage Mode'' speed buff added. *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **Summoned enemies no longer give money when damaged. **''Permanent Shield'' ability removed. **''Stomp'' now deals 750 damage to [[units]]. **''Rage Mode'' can now spawn between 2-4 [[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]]s instead of 2-3. **[[Partial Electric Immunity]] replaced with [[Energy Immunity]]. **[[Units]] no longer deal damage to '''Nuclear Fallen King''' during ''Rage Mode'' and ''Block'' ability, but instead pass through it. **{{Bug}} Death animation does not play; instead the '''Nuclear Fallen King''' continues walking until it gets to a corner. There it will remain to the end of the match. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **'''Nuclear Fallen King''' removed. {{FallenNuclear|[[Fallen Hero (Legacy)|Fallen Hero]]|Wave 39|Nuclear Fallen King & [[Fallen Guardian (Legacy)|Fallen Guardian]]|Wave 40|[[Glitched Giant]]|[[Hidden Wave (Legacy)|Hidden Wave]]}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[Category:Polluted Wasteland]]
